title: De Branges Reproducing Kernels, the Universal Transverse Square-Cascade for Lehmer Pairs, and the Leibniz-Wronskian Identity for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: We establish three exact structural identities linking Hilbert spaces of entire functions, critical-line zero coalescence, and multiplicative prime-sieve gauges to the transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-function: (1) the exact De Branges reproducing kernel identity K_alpha(t-id, t-id) = (alpha/pi)*W_tilde(d,t) and finite Cauchy-Pick Gram matrix representation; (2) the universal transverse square-cascade c_{2m-1}(t_0) = [m/(m!)^2]*(Xi^{(m)}(t_0))^2 > 0 for arbitrary coalescence order m >= 1 and the 2D Lehmer-pair isotropic sum-of-squares bowl; and (3) the universal Leibniz-Wronskian identity W_tilde_M(d,t) = |M|^2*W_tilde(d,t) + |Xi|^2*W_tilde_{1,M}(d,t) combined with a 0%-overshoot truncated Euler-product sieve closing the Lehmer uncertainty zone under the explicit Gabcke-Olver remainder bound.
